disposition_reason: The text prints the lowest and highest K, Ca, Mg, Mn, Fe, Cu, Zn and Cr values among six laboratory extracts of wild bilberry fruit and leaves; toxic-metal values are supplement-only.

study.design: phytochemical and elemental characterization of laboratory extracts of wild bilberry fruit and leaves
study.origin: wild bilberry fruits and leaves, Bjelasica Mountain, Montenegro
study.method: extracts (infusion, ethanol maceration, Soxhlet) microwave digested in HNO3/H2O2; ICP-OES (iCAP 6500 Duo)

findings.material_label: Bilberry fruit extract, ethanol maceration (Vaccinium myrtillus)
findings.group: laboratory extract MFEM, wild bilberry from Bjelasica Mountain, Montenegro
findings.notes: Printed in text as the lowest K of all extracts across the six extracts; per-extract values for other elements are in Supplementary Table S2, which is not available. Dry extract, not whole fruit; duplicate samples, three replicates each.
